findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Bilinear.lean:143 `def Algebra.lmul : A →ₐ[R] End R A where __ := NonUnitalAlgHom.lmul R A`; Mathlib/Algebra/Module/LinearMap/Defs.lean:1026 `def mulLeft (a : A) : A →ₗ[R] A where __ := AddMonoidHom.mulLeft a`; no `lmul = mulLeft` lemma in Mathlib (grep `lmul_apply|mulLeft_eq_mul` returns nothing).
findings.fix: Bridge explicitly: `have hlmul : Algebra.lmul ℚ A a = LinearMap.mulLeft ℚ a := by ext b; simp` and rewrite with it (and add `simp only [Pi.sub_apply]` before the `exact` at line 182), or document the defeq in a comment.
findings.issue: `exp_mulLeft` is `(map_exp ha (Algebra.lmul ℚ A)).symm`, which only elaborates because `Algebra.lmul ℚ A a` is definitionally `LinearMap.mulLeft ℚ a`. These are different structure terms — `Algebra.lmul` is built from `LinearMap.mul = LinearMap.mk₂ R (· * ·) …` (Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Bilinear.lean:35, 143), while `LinearMap.mulLeft` is built from `AddMonoidHom.mulLeft` (Mathlib/Algebra/Module/LinearMap/Defs.lean:1026) — and Mathlib has no lemma equating them, only the pointwise `mul_apply'`/`mulLeft_apply`. The same style of unstated defeq appears at line 181-182, where `rw [congrFun (LieAlgebra.ad_eq_lmul_left_sub_lmul_right …) a]` leaves `(mulLeft ℚ - mulRight ℚ) a` and the `exact` closes it only via `Pi.sub_apply`.

findings.evidence: Exponential.lean:77-79 vs 90-91; Exp.lean:136-139 is the identical general statement.
findings.fix: Extract `dividedPower_mem_map_kostantForm (e h f) (i n) : Associative.dividedPower n (f (ι ℚ (e i))) ∈ (kostantForm e h).map f`, then `exp_zsmul_mem_map_kostantForm := exp_zsmul_mem hnil (dividedPower_mem_map_kostantForm …) t` and `exp_zsmul_conj_mem_map_kostantForm := exp_zsmul_conj_mem hnil (dividedPower_mem_map_kostantForm …) t hb`.
findings.issue: `exp_zsmul_conj_mem_map_kostantForm` copies the proof of `exp_zsmul_conj_mem` (Exp.lean:138-139, `mul_mem (mul_mem (exp_zsmul_mem …) hb) (exp_zsmul_mem … (-t))`) verbatim instead of instantiating it, because the reusable fact it needs — every divided power of `f (ι ℚ (eᵢ))` lies in `(kostantForm e h).map f` — is buried inline at lines 77-79.

findings.evidence: Exponential.lean:122-127 duplicates Exp.lean:101-103 modulo `sum_mem`/`AddSubgroup.sum_mem` and the extra `LinearMap.sum_apply` application step.
findings.fix: State the general lemma next to `exp_zsmul_mem` in Exp.lean — `{x : Module.End ℚ V} (hx : IsNilpotent x) {M : AddSubgroup V} (hM : ∀ n, ∀ v ∈ M, Associative.dividedPower n x v ∈ M) (t : ℤ) : v ∈ M → exp ((t : ℚ) • x) v ∈ M` — and reduce `exp_zsmul_apply_mem` to it via `dividedPower_mem_kostantForm`.
findings.issue: `exp_zsmul_apply_mem` re-runs the expansion pattern of `exp_zsmul_mem` (Exp.lean:98-103: destruct nilpotency, `exp_zsmul_eq_sum_zsmul_dividedPower`, `sum_mem`, `zsmul_mem`) for an `AddSubgroup` of a module. Nothing in that argument mentions the Kostant form, so the general statement is hidden inside a Kostant-specific theorem.

summary: Proofs are short and mostly robust, but `exp_mulLeft` type-checks only through an undocumented definitional equality between two unrelated wrappers (`Algebra.lmul` vs `LinearMap.mulLeft`), and the Kostant file re-derives two facts that already exist (or should exist) as general lemmas in Exp.lean instead of instantiating them.
